title: JobCam timeline and a photo's details

steps.caption: JobCam
steps.narration: The JobCam feed can also be read day by day. Here is the timeline, and what a photo keeps.

steps.caption: Grouped by day
steps.narration: Shots are grouped by day, newest first. The project is named beside each day.

steps.caption: A shot
steps.narration: Click a shot to open it full size.

steps.caption: When, who, project
steps.narration: Under it you see when it was taken, who took it, and its project.

steps.caption: Location
steps.narration: A location shows here when one was saved with the shot.

steps.caption: Tag and caption
steps.narration: The tag and the caption are at the bottom.

steps.caption: Star
steps.narration: Click the star to mark a favorite.

steps.caption: Next shot
steps.narration: The arrows move to the next shot.

steps.caption: Download
steps.narration: Download saves a copy of the photo.

steps.caption: Hide details
steps.narration: The i button hides the details, so more of the photo shows.

steps.caption: Close
steps.narration: Close brings you back to the timeline.

steps.caption: Starred
steps.narration: The shot you starred now carries a star.

steps.caption: Grid
steps.narration: Choose Grid to go back to the tiles.

steps.caption: Menu: JobCam
steps.narration: You'll find JobCam in the menu on the left.

youtube.title: How to use the JobCam timeline and photo details | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of the JobCam timeline in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will see job-site shots grouped by day, open one to read when it was taken, who took it and its project, star it, and move between shots.
